The '''Volunteer Coordination Advocate''' was an advocate seat on the early [[Players Committee]] Advocate Council, listed as Volunteer Coordination and Shadow Squadron Leader.

== Holders ==

Each range runs from the month the holder is first documented to the month the holder is no longer listed, as on [[Players Committee advocates]]. Each holder appears once, on the row that gives their whole tenure.
